eyebrow: The mistake that makes a test lie to you
code:
# the common mistake:
while true:
    GET /api/products/42   # same endpoint, same record, no pause

# this measures:
#   how fast ONE perfectly-cacheable path can be hammered
# it does NOT measure:
#   how the system behaves under real production traffic
caption: Uniform synthetic load routinely passes while the real system falls over on a mix the test never exercised.

steps.label: Data variety
steps.sub: a spread of cache/DB keys, not one hot record

code:
scenario:
  product_page:  weight 60%, think_time 3-8s
  cart_update:   weight 25%, think_time 2-5s
  checkout_pay:  weight  5%, think_time 5-12s
  search:        weight 10%, think_time 1-4s

# weights + think time from real traffic, not equal split
caption: The mix, and the pauses between steps, both come from real production data — not an equal split across endpoints.
